independent.summary: The handoff count is derived from `convo.pendingQuestions`, but that array is emptied/filtered when the owner replies or resolves the handoff (dashboard.js:183 and dashboard.js:213), so answered handoffs vanish from the week: an owner who replied to everything is told "0 questions passed to you" (line omitted entirely), and `handoffs` becomes a near-duplicate of `stillWaiting` rather than the week's handoff total the item promises.

The headline line is pushed unconditionally while every other line is zero-guarded, so an activity week driven only by `unanswered` (reachable when conversationRetentionDays is set below 7 and the sweep deleted the conversations whose UnansweredQuestion rows remain) emails "0 visitor messages answered across 0 conversations" — and the test named "zero-valued lines are omitted rather than printed as 0" uses a fixture with nonzero headline counts, so it never exercises the one line that cannot be omitted.

The "Most asked" list emails raw visitor question text without consulting `entity.doNotRelay`, which notifications.js deliberately strips from owner-facing handoff SMS/email bodies, so a topic the owner listed as never-relay (e.g. salary questions) still reaches them verbatim in the weekly digest.

`lastWeeklyDigestAt` is stamped before the send, so a transient Resend failure loses that entity's digest for the whole week — the catch only console.errors, the 6-day guard plus the single matching day+hour means no retry is possible until the next scheduled tick.
